hebrewText: שְׁאַל לְ/ךָ֣ א֔וֹת מֵ/עִ֖ם יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑י/ךָ הַעְמֵ֣ק שְׁאָ֔לָה א֖וֹ הַגְבֵּ֥הַּ לְ/מָֽעְלָ/ה

tokens.bdb: to inquire; by implication, to request; by extension, to demand
tokens.kjv: ask (counsel, on), beg, borrow, lay to charge, consult, demand, desire, [idiom] earnestly, enquire, [phrase] greet, obtain leave, lend, pray, request, require, [phrase] salute, [idiom] straitly, [idiom] surely, wish.

tokens.bdb: a signal (literally or figuratively), as aflag, beacon, monument, omen, prodigy, evidence, etc.
tokens.explanation: ot — sinal, marca, presságio, milagre, evidência

tokens.bdb: adverb or preposition, with (i.e. in conjunction with), in varied applications; specifically, equally with; often with prepositional prefix (and then usually unrepresented in English)
tokens.kjv: accompanying, against, and, as ([idiom] long as), before, beside, by (reason of), for all, from (among, between), in, like, more than, of, (un-) to, with(-al).

tokens.bdb: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
tokens.kjv: Jehovah, the Lord. Compare H3050 (יָהּ), H3069 (יְהֹוִה).
tokens.explanation: YHWH — Nome próprio de Deus revelado a Moisés. Tradição massorética lê "Adonai"

tokens.bdb: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
tokens.kjv: angels, [idiom] exceeding, God (gods) (-dess, -ly), [idiom] (very) great, judges, [idiom] mighty.
tokens.enLiteralWord: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus
tokens.explanation: Elohim — nome hebraico de Deus. Plural de majestade. Denota o único Deus verdadeiro
tokens.explanationEn: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus

tokens.bdb: to be (causatively, make) deep (literally or figuratively)
tokens.kjv: (be, have, make, seek) deep(-ly), depth, be profound.

tokens.bdb: Hades or the world of the dead (as if a subterranean retreat), including its accessories and inmates
tokens.ptLiteralWord: Hades or the world of the dead
tokens.enLiteralWord: Hades or the world of the dead
tokens.explanation: Hades or the world of the dead
tokens.explanationEn: Hades or the world of the dead

tokens.bdb: desire (and so probably in Proverbs 31:4); hence (by way of alternative) or, also if
tokens.kjv: also, and, either, if, at the least, [idiom] nor, or, otherwise, then, whether.

tokens.bdb: to soar, i.e. be lofty; figuratively, to be haughty
tokens.kjv: exalt, be haughty, be (make) high(-er), lift up, mount up, be proud, raise up great height, upward.

tokens.bdb: properly, the upper part, used only adverbially with prefix upward, above, overhead, from the top, etc.
tokens.kjv: above, exceeding(-ly), forward, on ([idiom] very) high, over, up(-on, -ward), very.
